entries.source_access: Full article copy checked: https://pdfs.semanticscholar.org/2c3b/ef77179d5fdaf4faddee8a632af966cd3ab8.pdf; publisher record: https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1155/2011/765640.
findings: The revised results text accurately reports the article’s prose claim that MentatFuzzAll outperforms other variants on couple similarity/friendship, then flags its conflict with Table 2: random-friend RSimilarity is 0.77 for both MentatFuzzSim and MentatFuzzAll. Table 2 marks crisp-friendship cases as all couples being friends, so those are not graded comparisons. Source: Section 6, Table 2 and discussion, printed pp. 16–17 (PDF pp. 15–16).

The ANOVA p<.001 statement is distinct from the table conflict and supported by the article’s reported tests. Logistic friendship equations/parameters, no-decay limitation, model variants, and internal-comparison caveat were also rechecked and remain accurate (Section 5.2, Eqs. 5.1–5.3, Figures 4–5; Section 6).
